items.title: Former DUP leader Donaldson sentenced to 15 years in prison for child sex abuse
items.summary: Jeffrey Donaldson was convicted of 18 counts of sex abuse, including one of rape, which he committed against two women when they were children.

items.title: Trump calls off livestream of Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad
items.summary: Trump said some would "rather not watch" the killing of Nidal Hasan, the first military execution in over 60 years.

items.title: Trans people should use hospital spaces according to biological sex, NHS England says
items.summary: New guidance says trans patients should be cared for on single-sex hospital wards or bays that align with their biological sex.

items.title: Russell Brand accuser says he turned 'monster-like' before alleged rape
items.summary: The 51-year-old faces three counts of rape, three charges of sexual assault and one of indecent assault.

items.title: Banks say Healey is planning Budget tax raid on their profits
items.summary: Senior banking executives have told the BBC they expect to be "on the menu" in the chancellor's Budget tax later this month.

items.title: Meghan makes first official public appearance since moving back to UK
items.summary: The Duke and Duchess of Sussex are taking part in a series of events linked to their charitable work in Nottingham.

items.title: Watch: Swimmer's emotional TV plea for cancer research leads to meeting with PM
items.summary: Scottish athlete, Archie Goodburn, who was diagnosed with three inoperable brain tumours two years ago, met Andy Burnham after an appeal for more investment into brain cancer research.

items.title: Severe drought declared in parts of southern England
items.summary: Reservoir levels continue to drop after a hot summer and less September rain than normal.
